Attached: 1 image

Firefly III v6.7.0 just rolled out with a major UI overhaul! 💸 The open-source personal finance manager switched to Bootstrap Icons and Blade templates, giving us a fresh AdminLTE layout. You'll find redesigned transaction forms and a handy unified view for all transactions.

Release: https://github.com/firefly-iii/firefly-iii/releases/tag/v6.7.0
Run it on PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=firefly-iii

#selfhosted #opensource
